title: Jeff POST /v1/decide request
description: Exactly one of three shapes. 'calls': up to 256 function calls, answered in order. 'dispatch': one input routed through router functions to the function that should answer it. 'graph': a registered graph (by id) or an inline graph without code nodes and with at most 256 nodes. on_low_confidence says what happens when a decision abstains: 'return' it (the default), raise LowConfidence ('error'), or escalate through other functions in order (function references only, at most 256); escalation to an LLM, a person or another server runs in the SDK, not here.

context.description: Context field code name -> value: each field by the code_name GET /v1/functions lists for it (the manifest's key itself unless that key has spaces or other characters a name in code cannot have, for example counterparty_name for the key 'counterparty name'); null is the same as leaving it out.

labels.description: An object of label key -> description (null for none), or a list of label keys for a function that offers a subset of its own labels; null is the same as leaving it out.

router.description: The router to start from; jeff.core.router when absent.

allOf.description: An inline graph has at most 256 nodes.

escalate.description: Function references to try in order, each implementing the same interface.
